details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{Edim}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H)-1$.
proof: The cited theorem gives $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H)\leq\operatorname{height}(\mathcal H)$, while its height--eluder proposition gives $\operatorname{height}(\mathcal H)=\mathrm{Edim}(\mathcal H)+1$. Rearranging yields the displayed affine bound.
proof_source: Theorem 'Height controls list replicability' and Proposition 'Height and eluder dimension are equivalent' in the cited paper.
name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / List Replicability Number (affine)
